hypothesis: The repaired ordinary route handles an unavailable course resource with one bounded generation, saves only the explicit not-started personal fact and carries it into the next session; a request to help in this chat must never become a personal goal.

cases.expected: 实际读回本人尚未开始原话；不存先处理这个问题为目标；有界回复不添加网站故障原因、效果主张、期限或新任务，不生成完成经历，正常生成最多一次。
